game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair, a basalt column stairway: the forge smith must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Basalt Stair open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair: a basalt column stairway
core_gameplay_loop: In Basalt Stair, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Basalt Stair open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round, magma slimes strike the ash barrier, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ash barrier from magma slimes in Basalt Stair: keep the gates_open meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: gates_open drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Basalt Stair'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Basalt Stair.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while gates_open > 0.
